description: This Java source file defines the implementation of an AMQP connection management class named HonoConnectionImpl, used within the Eclipse Hono framework. It handles establishing, maintaining, and disconnecting from a Hono service endpoint using vertx-proton for AMQP communication, including connection retries, link management, and event handling.
